rule.text:
Students must complete a minimum of 24 upper division units in the major. Additional elective units may be needed to bring total to 24 required upper division units. A maximum of two elective courses may be taken outside of the Department of Integrative Biology.
Complete additional units in the following courses:
- Any INTEGBI 100-196 level course
- BIOENG 102
